worldcombat.skill.shockwave.summary: A jolt that lands the instant it is fired, with no random accuracy roll: the direct form flashes along a straight line to the target, while the ground form sweeps a ground-hugging corridor along your aim and may be fired empty; the first body or block in the way is the real endpoint. A soaked or rain-wet target conducts it harder.
With the ground form off, the current flashes along the straight line from the user to the target; the first body or block in the way is the endpoint. A non-ally hit takes about %1$s damage, and a soaked or rain-wet target takes %2$s more.

With the ground form on, the current sweeps a ground-hugging corridor along your aim at a longer range with more windup and cooldown; every non-ally along it is hit once for about %1$s damage, and soaked or rain-wet targets take %3$s more as well. Corridor half-width %2$s blocks. It can be swept with no target.
worldcombat.skill.shockwave.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.shockwave.growth.0: At level %1$s: direct power %2$s, ground power %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.shockwave.use.0: A jolt that lands on the instant
worldcombat.skill.shockwave.use.1: Sweep a corridor along the ground
worldcombat.skill.shockwave.preference.g: On: the current sweeps a ground-hugging corridor along your aim, hitting everyone along it at a longer range, but each target takes the ground power, with 2 ticks more windup and 5 ticks more cooldown. Off: a direct single strike that flashes along a straight line, heavier and faster.
worldcombat.skill.shockwave.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of firing. Larger values open up further.
On: soaked or rain-wet targets are fired at first, since water conducts the jolt harder. Off: order it like a plain ranged attack.
On: the user may leave its post to find a line of fire; off: it only fires from where it stands.
